title: How are you creating trailers for your games?
author: Three_Tails_Studio
selftext:
I am struggling to create a good trailer for my games. Are you using screen capture tools and then editing in something like DaVinci Resolve? Or has anyone had success getting Opus 5.5 or Astra to create the trailer for them?

Would like to hear what has actually worked for you.

comments.author: DamnrightWorldsDev
comments.body: "please make a trailer. make it good"

replies.author: Three_Tails_Studio
replies.body: If it was only that easy lol! Honestly, in a years time it may be.

comments.author: johnesco
comments.body:
A discussion that has been going around on that is what Claude Motion can do, and what you can ask your LLM to do. Some names are Code Driven Animation, or AI Machinima.  
  
You can get your LLM to both play your game, and then output your game frame by frame and can compile videos (with sound) and add overlay text after or during. I made these with it:

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OGmvjN69dyc](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OGmvjN69dyc)

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=07P35rs1aik](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=07P35rs1aik)

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AYAgLkHSfw4](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AYAgLkHSfw4)

Some of the benefits is you get a solid framerate even on a low-powered machine instead of capturing the video. You do have to develop a bot that can play your game that the LLM can give instructions to,but AI can be the solution to that too.

comments.body: Ai made trailers are fucking garbage. This is basic video editing stuff you can YouTube or Google or pay somebody to do for you

replies.author: Three_Tails_Studio
replies.body: No need to be nasty kiddo.

replies.author: mechatui
replies.body: I’m not being nasty I’m being realistic if you create a ai trailer for your steam game it will look far worse

replies.author: GoGs0l0dev
replies.body:
Not at all, you need to give it a script and have it capture individual snippets for the trailer, and it can be very good, although you might need to iterate on some game captures a few times.

If you just “make me a trailer” agreed it will be shit.

replies.body: Based on the description it seemed to me that op does want to fully vibe a trailer rather than using it as a tool.
